description: S46 T3 (MG5-reads): mcp.server {name} is the one-server read — "everything": the full view, the agent SLUGS whose declares name one of its tools (the mcp.servers count expanded), and the server's last 20 audit rows newest-first. A public server omits `agent` (the tier already states it; an empty string would name nobody with a value — absence is the honest rendering). The change row here is a grant_declare: `server` is OMITTED where mcp_change holds NULL (a 0 would name a row that does not exist — the PolicyChangeView discipline carried), and the fixed-template summary is built from names and ids only, so no credential can ever sit in the audit (MG13).
